question: A dishonest shopkeeper promises to sell his goods at cost price. However he uses a weight that actually weighs 37% less than what is written on it. Find his profit percentage.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In cases of dishonest dealers promising to sell at cost price but using false weights:

Profit % = (Error ÷ Actual Value Given) × 100

⇒ Profit % = (37 ÷ 63) × 100

⇒ Profit % = 3700 ÷ 63 = 58 ⁴⁶⁄₆₃%

**∴ The correct answer is 58 ⁴⁶⁄₆₃%.**
